scope: Tool compatibility with original 16 planned PKPM scenarios; not 300 answers, paid LLM experiments or benchmark acceptance.
method: Each task and linked model original text reviewed together. Coverage judgments are explicit per task; no keyword-generated capabilities.

precisionObservation.scope: Small axial forces under lateral loads; original numerical tolerances and failed receipts retained.

remainingSharedValidation: Future multimodal attachments and model interpretation are evaluated when authored; their current absence is not a tool failure.

Capability acceptance is separate from an LLM correctly clarifying or editing a task. Shared services implement exact ID edits, run-version binding, nodal differences and controlling-result comparisons.
